answer: A candidate deposits 25 POA in a opal escrow for 14 epochs and solves 6 serial challenges whose next seed depends on the prior result. 7 of 10 random graders seal the trace with a karst commitment and a public reef proof. For identities sharing timing or model fingerprints, required work and collateral double per member, so k sybils pay exponential compute plus 25(2^k-1) POA. Nodes replay seeds, verify locks, and check grader signatures.
